title: Challenges in Deploying AI Models
content: Building an AI customer support agent works perfectly, answering questions with a few lines of code. However, deploying it to 100,000 customers reveals different problems. Ensuring the model provides correct information, handling model provider failures, and preventing malicious prompts are significant challenges. Managing memory and deciding which model answers which request are also crucial. Using powerful models for every message can be expensive. Deciding which actions require approval and monitoring the agent's performance are additional complexities.
